'''Tatooine/3''' was a [[system cell]] serving [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Based on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Murtan Andes]] led the cell. After the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents had fled their base, Andes was ordered to dismantle the cell and take essential personnel to the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]] by [[Pouquor Elegin]] of [[Sedition]].<ref name="ISB" />
